e.title: IFoA 官方资格路径（Qualify）
e.summary: 英国精算师协会官方学习入口：课程体系（Curriculum）、考试安排、实务经历与三阶段专业技能训练
e.summary_en: The Institute and Faculty of Actuaries’ official study portal: curriculum, exam arrangements, practical experience and three-stage Professional Skills Training
e.summary_hk: 英國精算師協會官方學習入口：課程體系、考試安排、實務經歷與三階段專業技能訓練
e.body: IFoA（Institute and Faculty of Actuaries，英国精算师协会）的官方学习入口 **Qualify**（`actuaries.org.uk/studying`）是英国精算资格路径的权威起点，结构分四大块：**Qualify**（Become an actuary 入门、**Curriculum 课程体系**、**Exams 考试**——含考试日期与必备资源、**After exams**——成绩缓解情形/申诉/咨询、**Personal and Professional Development**——**实务工作经验是资格的组成部分**）；**Learn**（Lifelong learning、**CPD 持续专业发展**、**Professional Skills Training 专业技能训练三阶段**、Regional societies 区域分会、志愿者机会）；**Events**（活动日历、征稿、第三方活动）；**Insight**（政策与公共事务）。对 RIAA：IFoA 体系的特点是**「考试 + 实务经历 + 分阶段专业技能训练」三位一体**——资格不是考完试就结束，这与 SOA/CAS 的侧重不同，是理解不同市场精算职业制度的良好对照；香港有大量 IFoA 资格持有者，与本地 [[ashk]]、以及英国体系在港的落地直接相关；考试资源侧见 [[ifoa-formulae-tables]]（官方公式表）、[[ifoa-ai-innovation-2026]]（AI 与新兴风险实践领域）、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]（CMI 死亡率预测，持续教育体系的一部分）；三体系对照见 [[soa-education]] 与 [[cas-syllabus]]，职业发展侧见 [[ifoa-jobs]]、[[industry-cpd]]；适合作资格路径规划、实务经历要求与长期职业发展设计。
e.body_en: IFoA’s (Institute and Faculty of Actuaries) official study portal, **Qualify** (`actuaries.org.uk/studying`), is the authoritative starting point for the UK actuarial qualification pathway, structured in four blocks: **Qualify** (Become an actuary, the **curriculum**, **Exams** — dates and essential resources, **After exams** — mitigating circumstances, appeals and counselling, **Personal and Professional Development** — where **practical work experience is a component of the qualification**); **Learn** (lifelong learning, **CPD**, three-stage **Professional Skills Training**, regional societies, volunteering); **Events** (calendar, calls for speakers, third-party events); and **Insight** (policy and public affairs). For RIAA: the IFoA system is distinctive for combining **"exams + practical experience + staged professional skills training"** — the qualification does not end when the exams do — which differs in emphasis from the SOA and CAS and makes a good comparison for understanding actuarial professions across markets; Hong Kong has many IFoA-qualified actuaries, tying directly to the local [[ashk]] and the UK system’s presence in the city; on exam resources see [[ifoa-formulae-tables]] (the official formulae and tables), [[ifoa-ai-innovation-2026]] (the AI and emerging risks practice area) and [[cmi-mortality-projections]] (CMI mortality projections, part of the continuing education system); for the three-system comparison see [[soa-education]] and [[cas-syllabus]], and for career development [[ifoa-jobs]] and [[industry-cpd]]; suits qualification-pathway planning, practical experience requirements and long-term career design.
e.body_hk: IFoA（Institute and Faculty of Actuaries，英國精算師協會）的官方學習入口 **Qualify**（`actuaries.org.uk/studying`）是英國精算資格路徑的權威起點，結構分四大塊：**Qualify**（Become an actuary、**Curriculum 課程體系**、**Exams 考試**、**After exams** 成績緩解/申訴/諮詢、**Personal and Professional Development**——**實務工作經驗是資格的組成部分**）；**Learn**（Lifelong learning、**CPD**、**Professional Skills Training 三階段**、Regional societies、志願者機會）；**Events**；**Insight**（政策與公共事務）。對 RIAA：IFoA 體系的特點是**「考試 + 實務經歷 + 分階段專業技能訓練」三位一體**——資格不是考完試就結束，這與 SOA/CAS 的側重不同，是理解不同市場精算職業制度的良好對照；香港有大量 IFoA 資格持有者，與本地 [[ashk]] 直接相關；考試資源側見 [[ifoa-formulae-tables]]、[[ifoa-ai-innovation-2026]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]；三體系對照見 [[soa-education]] 與 [[cas-syllabus]]，職業發展側見 [[ifoa-jobs]]、[[industry-cpd]]；適合作資格路徑規劃、實務經歷要求與長期職業發展設計。
